nom: PEACH & LILY Ginger Melt Oil Cleanser

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin (via partner) reports it removes sunscreen easily without extra oiliness, though a sensitive-skin user found the same formula irritating.
segments.dry: Several reviewers report no dryness or tightness after use, describing skin as soft, hydrated, and not stripped, though one reviewer with dry patches said it was not moisturizing and left dry patches.
segments.combination: Two reviewers with combination skin report it does not increase oiliness or cause breakouts and is used alone on days when their skin feels dry to avoid stripping the barrier further.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it is gentle, fragrance-light, and causes no issues even with eczema or extreme eye-area allergies, while at least one reviewer with sensitive skin reports a burning reaction with redness and swelling around the eye.
segments.mature: No reviews specifically identify mature skin.

concerns.aging: One reviewer reports a visible reduction in redness with regular use of a related product line, but no reviewer specifically attributes anti-aging effects to this cleanser itself.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report skin feels soft, hydrated, and not tight or dry after use, including one who called out relief for eczema-prone skin; a minority report dry patches or a stripped feeling.
concerns.redness: Only one reviewer references redness improvement, tied to a different product in the same skincare line rather than this cleanser directly.
concerns.barrier: One combination-skin reviewer uses it alone on dry-feeling days specifically to avoid further stripping the skin barrier, and others describe it as non-stripping.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports finally clearing stubborn pore congestion around the chin after use; another reports pores clog up if she skips using it.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: multiple reviewers describe breakouts, new small pimples, or a full breakout starting soon after use, including one who says the product broke out both herself and a friend; others report the opposite, with acne improving, breakouts on the chin resolving, and no new blemishes after initial use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes it pulls oil and dirt from pores around the nose despite not having naturally oily skin, and another reports it works well for a partner's oily skin without complaint.

aspects.libelle: Fails to remove eye makeup or mascara
Light, watery texture requiring more product

extraits.titre: Feels like I got a chemical burn from a cleanser
extraits.texte: This has to be the worst cleanser ive ever used. I chose this as my birthday reward from ulta because I ran out of my preferred Biossance oil cleanser, but I really wish I'd picked anything else. I didn't have the watery texture I now see others have complained about, but rather it was such a thick oil that it was a struggle to rinse it off. I tried using it to remove the Elizabeth Arden chemical sunscreen I was wearing (no makeup), but it had a very hard time doing so. It also started to burn while I was trying to break up the sunscreen (I do have sensitive skin, but not so sensitive that I can't use AHAs/BHAs or retinal, none of which are even in this). I got the slightest bit along my lash line of one eye (which, since it is supposed to work on eye makeup should have been okay) and not only did that burn, but it caused that area of my lash line and eyelid to turn red and swell. In fact, it still hurts to blink today, more than 16 hours and a full night's recovery after use. Other areas of my face look chemical burned as well. I don't know what ingredient(s) burned me but I wouldn't recommend this cleanser to anyone. I've never had a strong reaction like this to one and for it to be ineffective as well is just icing.

Have been using this oil cleanser for over a month, but will only use 1-2 times a week and always double cleanse. It isnt very tough on makeup and some sunscreens, so I really only use it on days that i wasnt heavy on makeup and want a little extra exfoliation. It does an excellent job at removing those pesky sebum heads on my nose and i dont feel dried out after. It don't clog my pores and makes my skin so smooth. The very first couple of uses i broke out in the tiniest pimples, but as quickly as they came, they disappeared; continued use of this cleanser did not produce any more pimples. Needless to say, avoid if you like daily/semi-daily full coverage makeup or mineral sunscreen.

This cleanser has worked WONDERS for my skin. I use it in conjunction with the cleanser and I feel like my acne has improved so much. My hyper pigmentation has also gone down a ton. Cleans my face without feeling yucky, I let my mom try the trial size and it's a huge hit!!! ABSOLUTE necessity for acne prone skin!

Second time buying this - it lasts me forever and the formula just helps keep my eczema-prone skin feeling moisturized after washing. It's extremely gentle so it isn't my favorite thing to use on days when I wear more makeup, especially waterproof eye makeup. It work best for me as a basic daily cleanser when I'm wearing minimal makeup

I LOVE THIS. This is the first step in my routine. I double cleanse and honestly if I'm feeling lazy or if my skin is very dry (I have combination skin), I'll use this by itself to avoid stripping more moisture from my skin barrier. This is a double cleanse product MUST HAVE! Double cleanse products, 10/10

extraits.titre: By Far the Best Oil Cleanser I've Tried
extraits.texte: Love everything about this oil cleanser. I have combination skin and this does not make me oiler. It also does not cause me to break out. I'd purchase again and again.

extraits.titre: Irritates sensitive skin but great for oily skin
extraits.texte: This one irritates my sensitive skin but it is great for my boyfriend's oily skin. Gets sunscreen off easily. For the large bottle because he uses it everyday.
